data.title: Emaar Bayview
data.about:
Bayview by Emaar at Address Resorts provides high-end residences on the coast of the Arabian Gulf. This gem was created with the sole intention of providing an unparalleled adventure. 

Envision yourself waking up to the sight and sound of blue waters and gentle waves. The apartments and penthouses at Bayview range in size from one to six bedrooms. Every home has been carefully crafted to make your time spent here memorable.

Beautiful residences are only the beginning of what Emaar Bayview has to offer. Unwind on your very own beach and enjoy the sunshine. Relish in a luxurious array of services and facilities designed specifically for your enjoyment.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy a serene private beach for a tranquil experience
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Starting Price AED 3.3M
  • 90/10 Payment Plan
  • Luxurious apartments and penthouses under the Address Resorts brand
  • Enjoy a serene private beach for a tranquil experience.
  • Exclusive amenities floor on the 9th floor.
  • Convenient access to the Promenade.
  • Impressive landmark towers with the latest technology.
  • Experience breathtaking panoramic sea views.

location_tile.title: Bayview is situated on the exclusive island community of Emaar Beachfront
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Bayview is close to some of Dubai’s most renowned attractions. The neighbouring Dubai Marina and The Palm Jumeirah provide a wide range of opportunities to enhance your quality of life through entertainment, dining, and recreation.

  • Direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road
  • The Palm Jumeirah
  • 5 mins to Dubai Marina
  • Ain Dubai
  • Cruise Terminals
